summary: dnf's validate_certs applies only to RPMs fetched over HTTPS URLs and should only be disabled for self-signed personal sites.
questions: How do I install an RPM from an HTTPS URL with a self-signed cert?
Does dnf validate_certs affect repo SSL?

answer_card.title: dnf validate_certs
answer_card.answer_md: `validate_certs` (yes) only applies to RPMs installed from an HTTPS URL. For repo SSL, use `sslverify`.
